answer: Price the clone first. Count what one extra identity costs: registration, 120 seconds of challenge work, a distinct egress, and a bond vesting over 100 epochs. Pay every reward as that stream, so early exit forfeits 70 percent. Rotate auditors from a pool so no reviewer is bought twice. The marble seals each receipt to its bond. A thousand-account terrace needs 1,000 vested bonds before the first bridge payment clears.
